rule: Every tool has exactly one owning layer, the layer whose requirement names its primary job; any other layer lists it under 'uses'. Two different tools that do the same job become one comparison owned by one layer. Two tools whose roles differ both stay, each with its role stated.
trading_rule: The 12 us-equities layers own only trading-specific capabilities; shared infrastructure (agents, memory, scheduling, observability, storage tooling, CI, evaluation, secrets) is used from the owning foundation layer, not selected again (evidence/artifacts/new-wsl-clean-install-selection-20261001/ownership.json, accepted by the trading lane owner 2026-10-01). Requirements the user pinned are not judged: the NautilusTrader destination with its IBKR path, and the separate Alpaca adapter path.
supersedes: This map supersedes only the per-row winner lists of the architecture edition's 12 trading rows (catalogs/foundation/new-wsl-architecture-20261001.json), where alpaca-py, EdgarTools, DuckDB, exchange_calendars and NautilusTrader each appeared in several rows. It does not change closure state: the research state's statuses (8 comparison_required, 4 on_requirement_change) and the owner's verdict of 2026-10-01 ('selection of record, open', docs/decisions/2026-10-01-trading-layer-verdicts.md) describe the same open state, mapped in docs/decisions/2026-10-01-new-wsl-architecture-edition.md.
